title: Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-2529: PR #2529 merged without a green checks run
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation mergeaudit --probe 2529
**Status:** closed

MERGE-AUDIT-1: PR #2529 (tenant-sync: ledger [skip ci]) merged at 2026-11-26T16:58:07Z with its `checks` run at `missing` on head 755d9d5. Some merge path skipped the green gate.

Fix what that run caught on main (run the failed step from .github/workflows/checks.yml locally), then confirm a later merged PR passed `checks`. Do not weaken a check.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-26T17:08:55Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T23:04:15Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
